author: Praxis IV
title: FWPCA + PBVE‑lite (t=0.5, clamp[0.8,1.25]) on embedding PCs → kNN50 (cosine)
abstract: Applies PBVE‑lite in PC space on top of a Feature‑Weighted PCA embedding, then builds vanilla kNN50 (cosine), binary connectivities + true distances. Tests synergy vs redundancy of variance‑based methods on the simple scaffold.
